decision: REJECT isolated concept; do not integrate or render full scene. Retain canonical V018.

limits: Isolated geometry/neutral diagnostics only, not an actual-scene palette comparison; no botanical species claim.
recommendation: Stop this recipe without parameter tuning or additional scene renders. A future direction would need a genuinely different branch-level construction, not thinner versions of these upright cuffs. No such new work authorized by this review.
